authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1135 ātman explicitly gives Hindi āp respectful you, Old Marwari āpa self/honorific you/inclusive we and Gujarati āpaṇ inclusive we, beside Middle Indo-Aryan appā/appaṇa. The selected āp/āpaṇa/apaṇa/āpu/apu/apũ responses fit that reflexive-pronoun family with regional final vowels and nasalisation retained. Source person, inclusivity and politeness labels remain exact; local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: apũ.
